name: jambonz RetellAI SIP Integration
description: The jambonz helper applicaiton for RetellAI integration

RETELL_TRUNK_NAME.description: The name of the Carrier you configured in jambonz towards Retell

RETELL_SIP_CLIENT_USERNAME.description: The name of the Client you configured in jambonz for Retell

PSTN_TRUNK_NAME.description: Legacy alias for SKYSWITCH_CARRIER_NAME — the SkySwitch registration carrier used for transfer legs

SKYSWITCH_CARRIER_NAME.description: Name of the jambonz registration carrier for SkySwitch (default: SkySwitch-JambonzRetell)

SKYSWITCH_SIP_REALM.description: SkySwitch SIP realm for registration (e.g. visionquest.22393.service)

SKYSWITCH_REGISTER_USERNAME.description: SkySwitch SIP device username used for registration trunk auth (e.g. KickCalltest)

SKYSWITCH_EXTENSION_DOMAIN.description: SkySwitch domain for on-net extension transfers (defaults to SKYSWITCH_SIP_REALM)

NURSE_LINE_DID.description: 11-digit DID that maps to an internal SkySwitch extension for warm transfer

NURSE_LINE_EXTENSION.description: Short SkySwitch extension to dial for NURSE_LINE_DID transfers (e.g. 1009)

OWN_DIDS.description: Comma-separated own DIDs used to detect Retell-originated transfer legs

DEFAULT_COUNTRY.description: The 2 *CHARACTER* ISO-3166 Country Code for your phone number eg US, GB, ES, see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2 for values

OVERRIDE_FROM_USER.description: Value to use for From header in outbound calls to PSTN, original From callerID sent by Retell will be added to a Diversion header, use when SIPGATE is your carrier
